name: Car Studio — Guide lead form → ClickUp Inbound Leads

nodes.name: Form webhook
nodes.notes: Allowed Origins must list the exact origin the page is served from, or the browser blocks the POST before n8n ever sees it.

nodes.name: Build Inbound Leads row
nodes.notes: Maps the form fields onto the columns of the "Inbound Leads" table. Column ids are at the top of the code.

nodes.name: ClickUp: add row to Inbound Leads
nodes.notes: Adds one row to the "Inbound Leads" table (list 901817741951), which is what the 6-901817741951-8 channel displays. Needs a ClickUp API credential in n8n. On failure the visitor still gets the guide — the error branch keeps going.

nodes.name: ClickUp write failed
nodes.notes: ClickUp rejected the row. The visitor is still served the guide; the lead is in this execution log. Wire an alert (Slack/email) here so nothing is lost silently.

nodes.name: Respond 200
nodes.notes: The page serves the PDF from its own origin (EBOOK_URL in js/config.js), so no downloadUrl is needed here. Add `downloadUrl: "https://..."` to this response only if you switch to signed or expiring links — note that a cross-origin URL opens in a new tab instead of downloading.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, message: 'Some details are missing or invalid.', errors: $json.errors }) }}

main.node: ClickUp: add row to Inbound Leads
